messages:
sam: Heads-up — landing weights for caspia-13b v1 to s3://redwood-weights/onboard/caspia-13b/v1. Need tokenizer sanity checks + a quick toolcall smoke (structured outputs). tagging @eng-ml for async 🔎

anya: on it. quick Q: which config we're using for kv/cache + quantization? the manifest shows quant='gptq-4bit' but runtime expects 'q4_0'.

sam: good catch. manifest came from vendor. I'll update to q4_0 in the model.yaml but want tokenizer verified before pushing.

josh: i'll run tokenizer smoke now. last time we saw eos token split weirdly on this family — can cause JSON tool outputs to truncate.

li: FYI I saw the same with caspia-lite earlier. Patch we used was to set special_tokens.eos_token explicitly. sample config: ```yaml
tokenizer: 
  name: caspia-tokenizer-v2
  special_tokens:
    eos_token: ""
    pad_token: "<|pad|>"
```

josh: quick run results (local):
```
> python -m tests.tokenizer_smoke s3://redwood-weights/onboard/caspia-13b/v1/tokenizer
split_tokens: ok
detected_eos: '<|endoftext|>' vs expected '' -> mismatch
recommend: set eos_token to '' in tokenizer config
```

anya: thanks. i'll open a tiny PR to override special_tokens during onboarding so we don't need vendor edit. will also add a lint rule to catch eos mismatch.

sam: great. separate note on toolcall regression: please run the golden toolcall suite once weights + tokenizer fix are pushed. command: `./ci/run_golden.sh --model caspia-13b --suite toolcall-structured`

deploy-bot: deploy started for bucket sync -> staging-onboard (job id: db-7781). ETA ~6m. :gear:

josh: ran the toolcall smoke against current staging snapshot (before sync). Two failures: 1) structured output JSON had trailing newline causing parser error in our toolchain, 2) tool invocation returned truncated URL when description contained ```` (backticks). Logs: ```
FAIL: parse_error at test_tool_07 -> Trailing newline in json
FAIL: tool_invoke_03 -> url truncated: 'https://files.redwood...'
```

li: the truncated URL is consistent with eos mis-split — tokenizer inserted extra token that got interpreted as terminator. Once eos is fixed, retest. trailing newline might be a model generation artifact; i can add a post-processing strip in the toolcall wrapper as a safe guard.

anya: i'm adding two checklist items to the onboarding playbook: 1) tokenizer eos check, 2) toolcall postprocess strip-newline. also adding a quick regression that runs only those 8 golden prompts so it's fast.

sam: who can run the full golden suite after deploy completes? i'll triage issues if any.

josh: i can run it in ~30m once staging has the synced weights/tokenizer. will post a brief summary.

opsbot: job db-7781 completed -> staging-onboard sync success. artifacts: s3://staging-onboard/caspia-13b/v1/ (manifest.json included).

josh: re-run after sync: golden toolcall suite -> 8/10 passing. failures same as before but reduced. details: ```
- test_tool_07: still has trailing whitespace in generated JSON (low freq)
- tool_invoke_03: url truncation now isolated to prompts containing triple backticks
```

li: for the triple-backtick case we should escape backticks in prompt templates or send prompt as a structured input with metadata. i'll prototype escaping in the wrapper and push a small runtime-safe transform.

anya: PRs opened: #2145 (tokenizer override for eos), #2146 (toolcall postprocess strip), #2147 (prompt-escape for backticks). tagging reviewers @sam @josh. :rocket:

sam: awesome. plan: merge tokenizer PR first, wait for staged artifact, then merge postprocess & escape PRs. josh — once you get green on full suite can we promote to dedicated staging?

josh: yep. will run full regression after merges and give thumbs up.

sam: sweet. thanks all. i'll update onboarding checklist and mark caspia-13b as 'pre-staging ready' until final run. :white_check_mark:

anya: adding follow-up reminder for next-week retrospective to assess if we should add an automated lint for prompt backticks.

li: thanks. ping me if you want me to run an extended tokenizer fuzz test.

sam: closing loop — i'll watch the merges.
